notes: Not proven identical to author validation (8224 rows).
Author already evaluated PII-Bench; not independent of model selection.
ADDRESS full address maps to RU_ADDRESS; LOCATION constituents may still cover characters.
TOKEN maps strictly to AUTH_TOKEN; alternate secret classes remain visible in untyped coverage.
CVC is explicitly outside approved product scope; no new detector is added.
Clean/extra character counts refer only to annotation scope, not every project class.

before_k06.method: Existing strict span checker on saved real HTTP predictions, not a new full strict gate.

after_k06.method: Existing strict span checker on saved real HTTP predictions, not a new full strict gate.

qualifications: K06 reruns all 2318 cases with real Tiny2/Triton HTTP inference.
The baseline is the verified final K04 run; main/BERT is unchanged frozen E9, not a new run.
Only recognizers/json_strings.py and recognizers/ru_passport_ext.py differ in recorded candidate runtime sources.
The owner explicitly retained the pre-K01 false positive on Адрес: Подъезд 2.
No ground-truth edits, new acceptance thresholds, platform patches or automatic K/Q acceptance.
Extra masking on partially annotated data is not automatically a false positive.
Independent HTTP checks use real Tiny2/Triton, Analyzer and LiteLLM with a mock LLM provider; no external LLM calls.
The accepted narrative miss retains its original positive annotation and is not treated as a fixed case.
Test counts overlap and are not unique corpus cases.
Temporary containers and networks were removed; the seven main containers were unchanged.
K06-J01 does not claim compatibility with strict upstream numeric tool schemas; that limitation was explicitly accepted.
The typed text scanner handles JSON literal positions without blindly removing key quotes. Arbitrary model reformatting or nested recoding is not guaranteed exactly reversible.
The first failed HTTP fixture attempt is retained; only the complete repeated attempt is reported as passed.
Redis Lua, owner/reference scheme, TTLs, quotas, model, platform packages, environment settings and Make commands were not changed for K06-J01.

owner_decisions.scope: Six digits without series only with an immediate passport label or an exact own scalar key.

open_findings.problem: A numeric JSON scalar becomes an unquoted string placeholder. Captured native tool arguments must be inspected separately from exact text round-trip tests.

controlled_mask_diagnostic.method: existing mask function with controlled detector span, not a live provider test

resolved_findings.contract: Quoted source-number placeholders with explicit JSON-number provenance in request/Responses state. Client numbers restore as source literals; original strings stay strings.
resolved_findings.accepted_limit: A masked value is a string upstream; strict integer tool schemas are not automatically adapted.
